title: Devcontainer becomes the factory image: agents, hooks, and a git wrapper
summary: This change turns the devcontainer from a Rust-only build box into the full factory image. It pins and installs the task runner (moon), Node/pnpm/Bun, the GitHub CLI, actionlint, uv, the NVIDIA skill linters, and all four coding agents (codex, claude-code, opencode, omp), then builds this repo's own dsh/omp/opencode integrations from the pnpm lockfile and wires each agent's hook files to `osf hook`. It replaces the system-wide `core.hooksPath` with a root-owned git wrapper that forces the hooks path per invocation under the workspace, adds a `dsh` install from its own lockfile, and adds a suite of build-time tests that prove the wrapper, hooks, toolchain read-only-ness, and agent startup.

nodes.label: Dockerfile
nodes.subtitle: multi-stage toolchain install
nodes.summary: Pins and installs git-town, moon, gh, actionlint, uv, Node, pnpm, Bun, the four coding agents, dsh, and the NVIDIA skill tools, then builds the repo's own integrations and locks every root-owned path read-only.

nodes.label: Pinned tool installers
nodes.subtitle: curl + sha256sum -c per arch
nodes.summary: Each external tool is fetched from its own release tarball and verified against a published SHA-256, selected by TARGETARCH.

nodes.label: factory-build workspace
nodes.subtitle: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
nodes.summary: Builds integrations/dsh, integrations/omp and integrations/opencode from this repo's own pnpm lockfile so their dependency versions match what CI already tests.

nodes.label: dsh install
nodes.subtitle: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2
nodes.summary: dsh is installed from its own lockfile under /opt/dsh and symlinked onto PATH, separate from the pnpm workspace build.

nodes.label: SkillSpector / SkillEvaluator
nodes.subtitle: uv tool install at pinned commits
nodes.summary: The two NVIDIA skill-checking tools are installed from pinned 40-character commits, with UV_TOOL_DIR and UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR moved out of root's home so dev can read them.

nodes.label: Third-party skills
nodes.subtitle: skills@1.7.0 add --copy
nodes.summary: archify and archify-review are installed globally for opencode, codex and claude-code from a pinned commit tree URL.

nodes.label: git wrapper
nodes.subtitle: /opt/factory/bin/git
nodes.summary: Refuses --no-verify and -n on commit and --no-verify on push, and forces core.hooksPath=/opt/factory/githooks on the command line for every git call under OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT.

nodes.label: osf
nodes.subtitle: /opt/factory/bin/osf
nodes.summary: The factory CLI, built from this workspace and installed root-owned and read-only. It is the single entry point every hook file calls.

nodes.label: git hooks
nodes.subtitle: pre-commit, commit-msg, pre-push
nodes.summary: Root-owned hook scripts that each call osf; the wrapper points git at them per invocation instead of via system config.

nodes.label: /workspace bind mount
nodes.subtitle: OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT
nodes.summary: devcontainer.json binds the repository at /workspace and the image exports the same path as OSF_WORKSPACE_ROOT, so the wrapper and the mount never name it separately.

nodes.label: osf-path.sh
nodes.subtitle: /etc/profile.d
nodes.summary: Restores osf, the cargo toolchain and every agent binary to PATH for login shells, which otherwise reset PATH before reading profile.d.

nodes.label: Codex hooks
nodes.subtitle: /etc/codex
nodes.summary: Codex's system-level config, requirements and managed hook directory, wiring only the prompt event because Codex has no turn-end event.

nodes.label: Claude Code hooks
nodes.subtitle: .claude/hooks.json
nodes.summary: A UserPromptSubmit hook that runs `osf hook prompt`, installed both under the dev home and as a root-owned managed settings file.

nodes.label: dsh profiles
nodes.subtitle: factory and headless
nodes.summary: Both dsh profiles get the osf-dsh-plugin under node_modules plus a cordis.patch.yml registering the writing-check plugin and the Claude-format hooks bridge.

nodes.label: omp / opencode hooks
nodes.subtitle: home node_modules packages
nodes.summary: The omp and opencode hook files name their npm packages, so the built packages are installed under the dev home's node_modules where node resolves them.

nodes.label: osf hooks install --agents
nodes.subtitle: writes home hook files
nodes.summary: Runs at build time to write each agent's home hook files from osf.toml, then chowns the system copies root-owned and read-only.

nodes.label: git-wrapper.sh
nodes.subtitle: refusals and forced hooks path
nodes.summary: Proves the wrapper's refusals and the forced hooks path at build time, so a broken wrapper fails the build instead of shipping quietly.

nodes.label: agent-hooks.sh
nodes.subtitle: hook files root-owned, osf hook answers
nodes.summary: Reads the [agents] table from osf.toml and checks every enabled agent's hook file is root-owned and read-only, and that osf hook answers a sample payload per event.

nodes.label: toolchain-readonly.sh
nodes.subtitle: dev cannot write the toolchain
nodes.summary: Proves every root-owned toolchain folder is read-only for the dev user.

nodes.label: coding-agent-tools.sh / builder-tools.sh
nodes.subtitle: agents run as dev
nodes.summary: Proves each coding agent and every builder tool runs for the dev user, including from a login shell.

nodes.label: dsh-starts.sh
nodes.subtitle: both profiles boot
nodes.summary: Proves dsh starts with no credentials on both profiles, each stopping at the missing credential and nothing else.

nodes.label: image-clean.sh
nodes.subtitle: no root cache in a layer
nodes.summary: Proves no root cache or dsh session state reached a layer.

nodes.label: devcontainer-image.yml
nodes.subtitle: CI builds the image
nodes.summary: A GitHub Actions workflow that builds the devcontainer image, so the build-time proofs run in CI as well as locally.
